{"test_name": "Ledger_2297_Objection2", "test_code": "// Copyright (c) All contributors. All rights reserved.\n// Licensed under the MIT license. See LICENSE file in the project root for full license information.\n\nusing System;\nusing System.Collections.Generic;\nusing System.Collections.Immutable;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.Syntax;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\n\npublic class Ledger_2297_Objection2\n{\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task GeneratedFormattersAndResolversHaveExcludeFromCodeCoverage()\n    {\n        string testSource = \"\"\"\nusing MessagePack;\n\nnamespace TestProject\n{\n    public enum MyEnum\n    {\n        One = 1,\n        Two = 2,\n    }\n\n    [Union(0, typeof(UnionImplA))]\n    [Union(1, typeof(UnionImplB))]\n    public interface IMyUnion\n    {\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public class UnionImplA : IMyUnion\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public int Value { get; set; }\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public class UnionImplB : IMyUnion\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public string Name { get; set; }\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public class GenericObject<T>\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public T Value { get; set; }\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public class IntKeyObject\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public int Id { get; set; }\n\n        [Key(1)]\n        public MyEnum Kind { get; set; }\n\n        [Key(2)]\n        public IMyUnion Union { get; set; }\n\n        [Key(3)]\n        public GenericObject<int> Generic { get; set; }\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject(true)]\n    public class StringKeyObject\n    {\n        public string FirstName { get; set; }\n        public int Age { get; set; }\n    }\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> net80Refs = await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None);\n        MetadataReference[] allRefs = net80Refs.Concat(ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack)).ToArray();\n\n        CSharpCompilation compilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"TestAssembly\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(testSource, new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest)) },\n            allRefs,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator());\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(compilation, out Compilation output, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n\n        Assert.Empty(generatorDiagnostics.Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n        Assert.Empty(output.GetDiagnostics().Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n        Assert.Empty(runResult.Diagnostics.Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n        Assert.All(runResult.Results, r => Assert.Null(r.Exception));\n\n        List<GeneratedSourceResult> generatedSources = runResult.Results.SelectMany(r => r.GeneratedSources).ToList();\n        Assert.NotEmpty(generatedSources);\n\n        var checkedTypes = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);\n\n        foreach (GeneratedSourceResult generated in generatedSources)\n        {\n            SemanticModel semanticModel = output.GetSemanticModel(generated.SyntaxTree);\n            SyntaxNode root = await generated.SyntaxTree.GetRootAsync();\n\n            foreach (TypeDeclarationSyntax typeDecl in root.DescendantNodes().OfType<TypeDeclarationSyntax>())\n            {\n                if (semanticModel.GetDeclaredSymbol(typeDecl) is not INamedTypeSymbol symbol)\n                {\n                    continue;\n                }\n\n                bool isFormatterOrResolver =\n                    symbol.AllInterfaces.Any(i => i.Name is \"IMessagePackFormatter\" or \"IFormatterResolver\") ||\n                    symbol.Name == \"FormatterCache\";\n\n                if (!isFormatterOrResolver)\n                {\n                    continue;\n                }\n\n                bool hasExcludeFromCodeCoverage = symbol.GetAttributes().Any(attr =>\n                    attr.AttributeClass?.ToDisplayString() == \"System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute\");\n\n                Assert.True(\n                    hasExcludeFromCodeCoverage,\n                    $\"Generated type '{symbol.ToDisplayString()}' in '{generated.HintName}' is missing [ExcludeFromCodeCoverage].\");\n\n                checkedTypes.Add(symbol.Name);\n            }\n        }\n\n        string[] expectedTypeNames =\n        {\n            \"IntKeyObjectFormatter\",\n            \"StringKeyObjectFormatter\",\n            \"GenericObjectFormatter\",\n            \"MyEnumFormatter\",\n            \"IMyUnionFormatter\",\n            \"GeneratedMessagePackResolver\",\n            \"FormatterCache\",\n        };\n\n        foreach (string expectedName in expectedTypeNames)\n        {\n            Assert.Contains(expectedName, checkedTypes);\n        }\n    }\n}\n"}
